lab.quote: Our total paying supplier base was 2,17,000 at the end of quarter two, reflecting a net decline of 615 suppliers during the quarter.

call_memory.quote: Our total paying supplier base was 2,17,000 at the end of quarter two, reflecting a net decline of 615 suppliers during the quarter.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: IndiaMART's total paying supplier base stood at 2,17,000 at the end of Q2 FY27, reflecting a net decline of 615 suppliers during the quarter.

lab.quote: Our Platinum and Gold customers, which contribute approximately 50% of our customer base and about 75% of revenue, continue to have good upsell and retention rate.

call_memory.quote: Our Platinum and Gold customers, which contribute approximately 50% of our customer base and about 75% of revenue, continue to have good upsell and retention rate.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Platinum and Gold customers account for approximately 50% of IndiaMART's customer base and roughly 75% of revenue.

lab.quote: In Q2, we sold approximately 11,000 new licenses, bringing our total licenses sold to 4,66,000.

call_memory.quote: In Q2, we sold approximately 11,000 new licenses, bringing our total licenses sold to 4,66,000.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: BUSY Infotech sold approximately 11,000 new licenses in Q2 FY27, reaching a cumulative total of 4,66,000 licenses sold.

lab.quote: Consolidated other income was negative Rs. 8 crores during the quarter, primarily due to increase in bond yields, which led to MTM losses.

call_memory.quote: Consolidated other income was negative Rs. 8 crores during the quarter, primarily due to increase in bond yields, which led to MTM losses.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Consolidated other income was negative Rs. 8 crores in Q2 FY27 due to MTM losses driven by higher bond yields.

lab.quote: On EBITDA margin, IndiaMART, we have been guiding long-term 33% margin.

call_memory.quote: On EBITDA margin, IndiaMART, we have been guiding long-term 33% margin.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Management targets a long-term EBITDA margin of 33% for IndiaMART standalone business.

lab.quote: If you see our advertising expenses in the entire of last year are now running at Rs. 8 crores, Rs. 9 crores per quarter, and this is almost touching the Rs. 10 crore per quarter budget.

call_memory.quote: If you see our advertising expenses in the entire of last year are now running at Rs. 8 crores, Rs. 9 crores per quarter, and this is almost touching the Rs. 10 crore per quarter budget.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Advertising expenses are running at Rs. 8 crores to Rs. 9 crores per quarter, approaching a budget of Rs. 10 crores per quarter.

lab.quote: Rest assured, there is no question of us taking a huge capital risk.

call_memory.quote: Rest assured, there is no question of us taking a huge capital risk.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: IndiaMART is not committing any significant amount of capital to its early-stage credit enablement pilots and has no intention of taking huge capital risk.

lab.quote: On approximate numbers, it is about 50% of the customer base, Gold and Platinum, and about 75% of the revenue.

call_memory.quote: On approximate numbers, it is about 50% of the customer base, Gold and Platinum, and about 75% of the revenue.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Gold and Platinum suppliers account for approximately 50% of the customer base and generate about 75% of revenue.

lab.quote: 10% of our traffic, approximately, is now coming through the organic paid thing.

call_memory.quote: 10% of our traffic, approximately, is now coming through the organic paid thing.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Paid traffic currently contributes approximately 10% of IndiaMART's traffic, generating around 1 million unique business inquiries per month out of 26 to 27 million quarterly inquiries.

lab.quote: There could be almost 20%-40% cannibalization depending upon which particular area.

call_memory.quote: There could be almost 20%-40% cannibalization depending upon which particular area.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Paid traffic causes an estimated 20% to 40% cannibalization of traffic depending on the specific category or area.

call_points.text: Unique business enquiries declined 10-15% from highs due to Google AI Overviews and strategic data protection.
IndiaMART Finance will operate as a credit enablement tool with no significant capital commitment or large risk.
ESOP expenses have reached a baseline and are expected to remain at current levels until a new pool is created.
Silver tier 12-month retention is currently 10% lower than levels seen four to five years ago.
Management is not capitalising any AI research or manpower expenses; 100% is expensed through P&L.
Busy Infotech growth rates expected to return to 20-30% range from Q3 onwards as base effects normalise.
Board approved IndiaMART Finance Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary to partner lenders for short-term transaction financing.
Management could not say when net paying-supplier additions would resume, citing multiple ongoing experiments.
90-day repeat buyer rate is 58-59%, up from 50-51% over the years.
No numeric FY27 revenue, margin or supplier guidance is given in the presentation.
About ₹725 Cr has been invested in the accounting software space, including Busy Infotech and Livekeeping.

operating_notes.text: Group increased provision for employee benefits by ₹90.72 million following notification of new Labour Codes.
FY26 collections were ₹1,857 Cr, 12% YoY, and deferred revenue ₹1,965 Cr, 16% YoY, both ahead of 11% revenue growth.
Paying suppliers were 220K at FY26-end, up 1% YoY, with ARPU of ₹67K, up 8% YoY.
About ₹1,300 Cr of capital has been returned to shareholders, including ₹300 Cr distributed in FY26.
Supplier storefronts grew to 8.7 million and paying suppliers stood at 220K at the end of Q4 FY2026.
Total paying suppliers stood at 220,000 at the end of FY26, after a decline of 1,200 in Q4 due to Silver tier price hikes.
BUSY Q1 billing ₹59 Cr (+10% YoY), revenue ₹36 Cr (+47%), deferred revenue ₹146 Cr (+44%), cash from operations ₹16 Cr.
BUSY sold about 12,000 new licenses in Q1, taking cumulative licenses sold to 4.54 lakh.
Platinum and Gold subscribers are about 50% of the customer base and more than 75% of revenue.
Standalone paying suppliers declined by 615 in Q2FY27 to 217K.
Annualised Revenue Per Paying Supplier (ARPU) reached ₹72K in Q2FY27, up 10% YoY.
Busy Infotech Q2FY27 billing stood at ₹46 Cr (+20% YoY) and revenue at ₹37 Cr (+27% YoY).
Unique business enquiries stood at 27 million in Q2FY27.
Approximately 10% of traffic is now coming through paid advertising.
Busy Infotech sold 11,000 new licenses in Q2, bringing total to 4.66 lakh.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹404.3 Cr (+13.9% YoY), net profit ₹50.2 Cr.
IndiaMART reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹404 Cr with a net profit of ₹50 Cr and recommended a total dividend of ₹60 per share.

IndiaMART Q1FY27 call (July 21, 2026): revenue ₹414 Cr (+11% YoY), EBITDA ₹146 Cr at 35% margin, net profit ₹172 Cr; paying suppliers fell 1,850 to 2.18 lakh; board approved new subsidiary IndiaMART Finance Ltd.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹428.6 Cr (+9.6% YoY), net profit ₹90.8 Cr (+9.8% YoY) (includes ₹15.3 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹106.1 Cr).
IndiaMART InterMESH published its Q2FY27 investor presentation reporting consolidated revenue of ₹429 Cr (+10% YoY) and EBITDA of ₹159 Cr (+23% YoY).
Audio and video recording of Earnings Conference Call for Analysts and Investors held on October 27, 2026 is available on the company website.
On October 28, 2026, a one‑to‑one analyst/institutional investor call with DT Partners was held at 05:30 P.M. via over‑the‑air call, with no unpublished price‑sensitive information disclosed.
On October 31, 2026, IndiaMART published its Q2FY27 call transcript, highlighting a focus on Silver-tier churn and AI-led data protection.
